# Love4Prompts — Full Documentation for LLMs

> The universal prompt toolkit for every AI. One console bar that enhances, generates, and translates prompts across every major AI model. Free, no signup required.

---

## Overview

Love4Prompts (https://love4prompts.vercel.app) is a free web-based toolkit that helps users write better prompts for AI models. It provides six specialized tools accessible through both dedicated pages and a universal search bar on the homepage.

The site targets anyone who uses AI tools — from beginners who don't know how to write effective prompts, to power users who need to translate prompts between platforms or generate them at scale.

---

## Tools (Detailed)

### 1. Prompt Enhancer
**URL**: https://love4prompts.vercel.app/tools/prompt-enhancer
**Purpose**: Takes a rough, basic prompt and rewrites it into a detailed, structured, production-ready prompt.
**How it works**:
- User types a rough idea (up to 1000 chars)
- Selects target AI model (ChatGPT, Midjourney, DALL-E, Claude, Gemini)
- Optionally selects enhancement modes: More Detail, Add Examples, More Concise, Expert Level, Structure
- AI returns the enhanced prompt plus a list of specific improvements made
**API**: POST /api/tools/enhance
**Rate limit**: 5 free uses/day per browser

### 2. Prompt Translator
**URL**: https://love4prompts.vercel.app/tools/prompt-translator
**Purpose**: Converts prompts between AI platforms while preserving intent and adapting platform-specific syntax.
**How it works**:
- User selects source platform (e.g., Midjourney) and target platform (e.g., DALL-E)
- Pastes the source prompt
- AI translates and returns the adapted prompt plus a list of adaptations made
**Supported platforms**: ChatGPT, Midjourney, DALL-E, Claude, Gemini, Flux, Stable Diffusion
**API**: POST /api/tools/translate
**Rate limit**: 5 free uses/day per browser

### 3. Prompt Maker
**URL**: https://love4prompts.vercel.app/tools/prompt-maker
**Purpose**: Generates complete prompts from scratch based on a topic description.
**How it works** (3-step wizard):
1. Describe what you want (topic + use case category)
2. Select target model + optional style modifiers
3. AI generates a complete prompt with pro tips
**Categories**: Image Generation, Marketing, Code, Writing, Analysis, Conversation, Education, Business
**API**: POST /api/tools/generate
**Rate limit**: 5 free uses/day per browser

### 4. Image to Prompt
**URL**: https://love4prompts.vercel.app/tools/image-to-prompt
**Purpose**: Reverse-engineers any image into a text prompt that can recreate it.
**How it works**:
- User uploads an image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, max 4MB)
- Selects target AI model for prompt format
- AI analyzes the image and generates a detailed recreation prompt
**API**: POST /api/tools/image-to-prompt
**Rate limit**: 5 free uses/day per browser

### 5. Prompt to Image
**URL**: https://love4prompts.vercel.app/tools/prompt-to-image
**Purpose**: Generates images from text descriptions.
**How it works**:
- User types a text description
- Image is generated via Pollinations AI (free, no API key)
- Result can be downloaded or prompt copied
**External API**: https://image.pollinations.ai
**Rate limit**: Unlimited (uses free external API)

### 6. LinkedIn Post Generator
**URL**: https://love4prompts.vercel.app/linkedin-post-generator
**Purpose**: Creates optimized LinkedIn posts with professional formatting.
**Controls**: Topic, tone (Professional/Storytelling/Thought Leadership/Casual), length, CTA toggle
**API**: POST /api/tools/generate
**Rate limit**: 5 free uses/day per browser

### 7. Instagram Caption Generator
**URL**: https://love4prompts.vercel.app/instagram-caption-generator
**Purpose**: Generates Instagram captions with hashtags and emoji controls.
**API**: POST /api/tools/generate

### 8. Coding Prompt Generator
**URL**: https://love4prompts.vercel.app/coding-prompt-generator
**Purpose**: Creates structured coding prompts for AI coding assistants.
**API**: POST /api/tools/generate

---

## Universal Bar (Homepage Feature)

The Universal Bar at https://love4prompts.vercel.app is an intelligent search bar that:
1. Accepts any natural language input
2. Auto-classifies intent using an AI classifier (POST /api/tools/classify)
3. Routes to the appropriate tool backend (enhance, translate, generate, image, social, code)
4. Returns results inline without page navigation

**Keyboard shortcuts**:
- `Ctrl+K` (Windows/Linux) or `⌘+K` (Mac) — Focus the bar
- `Ctrl+Enter` or `⌘+Enter` — Submit

**Features**:
- Model selector (ChatGPT, Midjourney, DALL-E, Claude, Gemini)
- Intent detection pill (shows detected mode: Enhancer, Translator, Image Gen, etc.)
- Inline result panel with copy, execute (opens target AI), and refinement
- Bulletproof Mode — asks clarifying questions then generates a comprehensive prompt
- Recent prompts history (localStorage)

---

## Prompt Library

Accessible at https://love4prompts.vercel.app/#library on the homepage.
- Curated prompts stored in Supabase
- Filterable by style/category
- Each prompt card shows: title, prompt text, style tag, copy button
- Prompts are publicly browsable, no login required

---

## Supported AI Models

| Model | Company | Best For |
|-------|---------|----------|
| ChatGPT | OpenAI | Text, code, analysis, conversation |
| Midjourney | Midjourney Inc. | Image generation (artistic, detailed) |
| DALL-E 3 | OpenAI | Image generation (photorealistic) |
| Claude | Anthropic | Long-form text, analysis, coding |
| Gemini | Google | Multimodal, research, coding |
| Flux | Black Forest Labs | Image generation (open-source) |
| Stable Diffusion | Stability AI | Image generation (open-source, local) |

---

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend**: Astro 6 (SSR on Vercel), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion
- **AI Backend**: Groq API (Llama 3 70B) for text generation/enhancement/translation
- **Image AI**: Pollinations AI (free, no key) for prompt-to-image
- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL) for prompt library
- **Analytics**: Microsoft Clarity (session recording + heatmaps)
- **Hosting**: Vercel (serverless functions + static assets)
- **Rate Limiting**: Client-side localStorage-based (5 uses/tool/day)

## Site Structure

```
love4prompts.vercel.app/
├── /                          # Homepage (Universal Bar + Library)
├── /tools/prompt-enhancer     # Prompt Enhancer tool
├── /tools/prompt-translator   # Prompt Translator tool
├── /tools/prompt-maker        # Prompt Maker tool
├── /tools/image-to-prompt     # Image to Prompt tool
├── /tools/prompt-to-image     # Prompt to Image tool
├── /tools/                    # All tools index page
├── /linkedin-post-generator   # LinkedIn Post Generator
├── /instagram-caption-generator # Instagram Caption Generator
├── /coding-prompt-generator   # Coding Prompt Generator
├── /dashboard                 # User dashboard (prompt management)
├── /privacy                   # Privacy Policy
├── /terms                     # Terms of Service
├── /robots.txt                # Crawler directives
├── /llms.txt                  # This file (concise)
└── /llms-full.txt             # Full documentation (this file)
```
